meta.name: board-meeting
meta.description: Multi-agent board meeting protocol for strategic decisions. Runs a structured 6-phase deliberation: context loading, independent C-suite contributions (isolated, no cross-pollination), critic analysis, synthesis, founder review, and decision extraction. Use when the user invokes /cs:boardroom, calls a board meeting, or wants structured multi-perspective executive deliberation on a strategic question.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会模拟一场由多位高管（如CEO、CFO等）参与的董事会会议，按6个阶段逐步讨论你的战略问题，最终给出决策建议和行动项。
howto.when: 当你输入“/cs:boardroom [话题]”或要求召开董事会会议时触发。

say.text: 召开董事会讨论是否在Q3进军西班牙市场。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude simulates a board meeting with multiple executives (e.g., CEO, CFO) to discuss your strategic question through 6 phases, producing a decision recommendation and action items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type "/cs:boardroom [topic]" or ask to call a board meeting.
